recipe.ghg_method: Native EDGAR-consistent GHG total only, converted from kilotonnes to tonnes; source characterisation retained. Detailed gas/source rows and the separate OECD-consistent inventory are not added again. Native GWP vintage and residence/territorial bridge are not harmonised with EDGAR 2026.
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP at market prices: basic-price value added plus net product taxes
recipe.gdp_note: GLORIA GDP adds original product taxes and signed subsidies on intermediate and final commodity uses to the six basic-price value-added rows. The world income/expenditure check has a 0.019% source residual, reproduced by independent direct CSV sums; values are not balanced or adjusted. Source vintages may differ from World Bank national accounts.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.
recipe.attribution: GLORIA v060, University of Sydney / UNEP International Resource Panel. CC BY-NC 3.0 Australia. Non-commercial MARIO research indicators: six native value-added rows summed; native GHG CO2eq converted from kilotonnes to tonnes, with direct final-demand emissions included once. January 2026 economic tables and April 2024 satellite vintage. No endorsement is implied. GDP adds source-signed product-tax and subsidy valuations on intermediate and final uses.

license_basis.statement_supplied_by_user: GLORIA is made available under a Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial license. Commercial applications are managed by FootprintLab.
license_basis.application: Non-commercial MARIO documentation browser. Attribution and modification notices retained in snapshots, CSV and native-set downloads.

recipe.value_added_basis: Value added at basic prices; six explicit source factor rows
recipe.ghg_basis: Native EDGAR-consistent GHG total plus direct final-demand emissions; source CO2eq characterisation retained
recipe.gwp_basis: Native CO2eq; IPCC AR5 GWP100 verified for CO2, CH4, N2O, SF6 and NF3; other F-gases unverified
recipe.ghg_note: GLORIA retains its native EDGAR-consistent CO2eq total. Independent checks of the 2001 and 2024 gas rows recover AR5 GWP100 factors for CO2, CH4, N2O, SF6 and NF3. Individual factors for all fluorinated gases remain unverified; the 2024 cell-level gas-row fit has a relative L2 residual of about 0.15%. The EDGAR 2026 territorial boundary also differs.
recipe.scope_note: GLORIA 2013: economic vintage 20260121; satellite vintage 20240417. GDP includes the verified source product-tax valuation bridge.
recipe.gdp_quality_note: GLORIA 2013: the world income/expenditure check has a 0.019% source residual, independently reproduced from the original tables. The income-side GDP is retained without a balancing adjustment.

provenance.reading_scope: MARIO native Va/Vc/Ea/Ec/EY readers and canonical axes, float64. Full transaction blocks and inverses are not loaded. Signed product-tax valuations are independently streamed for the GDP bridge.

gdp_bridge.basis: Basic-price gross value added plus signed product-tax and subsidy valuations on intermediate and final commodity uses, including imports. Source subsidies enter with their original negative sign. Trade and transport margins are excluded from the tax bridge. All five final-demand valuations provide an independent world expenditure-side check.
gdp_bridge.documentation: GLORIA_ReleaseNotes_060.pdf, part II, National Accounting Identity; GLORIA_ReadMe_060.xlsx, Valuations and MR-SUT structure.

source_accounting_audit.reading_scope: Independent direct CSV scalar sums (NumPy), without MARIO block readers; V and all five Y valuations. Source labels, shapes and CRCs checked.
